canvas: Square 1:1 master, at least 1024x1024; final approved export is one opaque 512x512 WebP at the declared path.
promptAssembly: Use the exact final prompt: <styleLock> followed by a newline, then 'Scene: <scene>', then a newline, then 'Avoid: <negativePrompt>'.
styleLock: Create one premium dimensional painterly storybook icon for Maggie's Trail, centered on a clean warm-ivory #F7F3EC square. Hand-painted finish with fine brush texture, believable soft volume, restrained detail, and gentle top-left studio lighting; dimensional but never glossy plastic or photoreal. Use deep navy #0D1B2A for visual anchors and Summit Orange #F08A24 for one focal accent, with restrained sky blue or leaf green only when mathematically useful. One strong silhouette, clear at 32 to 80 pixels, generous 12 percent safe margin, no border or app-card chrome. The whole library must look commissioned by one professional illustration team.
negativePrompt: words, letters, numerals, equations as text, labels, watermarks, signatures, logos, people, faces, hands, avatars, photographic realism, glossy 3D plastic, flat vector line art, neon colors, dark background, transparent background, drop-shadow card, phone frame, busy scenery, multiple unrelated objects, cropped object, detail touching the canvas edge

assets.label: Numbers and place value
assets.scene: A sculptural base-ten learning set arranged as one elegant still life: a thousand cube behind a hundred flat, a ten rod, and a few unit cubes stepping forward like a trail; the smallest cube catches the single orange highlight.

assets.label: Operations and fluency
assets.scene: Two small groups of smooth counting stones visibly joining into one larger group, with a subtle carved plus-shaped join in the negative space and one orange stone at the meeting point.

assets.label: Fractions, ratios and percent
assets.scene: A round wooden fraction model separated into equal fitted wedges, several navy wedges and one lifted orange wedge, paired with two short ratio ribbons that clearly compare part sizes without written notation.

assets.label: Measurement
assets.scene: A softly curved measuring tape wrapping around a small dimensional wooden block, with clear tick marks but no numerals; one orange end-tab provides the focal accent.

assets.label: Time
assets.scene: A friendly but age-neutral round clock made of painted wood, using dot hour markers with no numerals; navy hands and one orange marker, readable instantly at small size.

assets.label: Geometry and shapes
assets.scene: A balanced miniature composition of a sphere, cube, triangular prism, and thin circular hoop, overlapping just enough to show depth; one orange triangular face is the focal accent.

assets.label: Angles and construction
assets.scene: A precision drawing compass opening over a translucent angle wedge and a short straightedge, arranged like refined mathematical tools; the compass hinge is Summit Orange.

assets.label: Algebra and equations
